item.title: Comprehensive architectural services for the work of Renovation of Executive Area at RBI Raipur, Sector 24, Nava Raipur
item.description:
Reserve Bank of India, Estate Cell, Raipur invites e-tender for the captioned work through Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP) from the Bank’s Empaneled Architect Firms for works above Rs. 1 Crore and up to Rs.5 Crore.

2. Estimated Cost of the work for which tender has been invited for comprehensive Architectural Services including Supervision of work is ₹3.58 Crore. The e-tendering would be done through the Central Public Procurement Portal (https://www.etenders.gov.in).

3. All interested eligible empaneled Architects must register themselves with CPP Portal through the above-mentioned website to participate in the tendering process.

Schedule of tender for the same is as follows:

a. e-Tender no RBI/RRO/EST/26-27/3
b. Name of work Comprehensive architectural services for the work of Renovation of Executive Area at RBI Raipur, Sector 24, Nava Raipur- 492101
c. Estimated cost ₹10.56 Lakhs
d. Mode of Tender e-Procurement System (Online Part I - Techno-Commercial Bid and Part II - Price Bid through https://etenders.gov.in)
e. Date of NIT available to parties to download (View Tender Time) November 14, 2026, 10:00 Hrs. onwards
f. Date of Starting of e-Tender for submission of on line Techno- Commercial Bid and price Bid November 17, 2026, 11:00 Hrs. onwards
g. Pre-Bid meeting Offline on November 16, 2026, at 11:00 Hrs.at the Office of the General Manager (Officer-in-Charge), Reserve Bank of India, Estate Cell (I-Floor), Sector 24 Atal Nagar, Raipur – 492101.
h. Retention Money Deposit 5% from each bill
i. Performance Bank Guarantee Successful tenderer shall submit Performance Bank Guarantee in the form of Bank Guarantee for a value equal to 5% of the total Contract value in the prescribed format which shall be valid till the stipulated date of completion of work plus 3 months. In case the time for completion of work gets extension, the Project Architect shall get the validity of the Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) extended to cover such extended time for completion of work.
j. Date of closing of online e-tender for submission of Techno-Commercial Bid & Price Bid November 24, 2026, at 15:00 Hrs.
k. Date & time of opening of Part-I (i.e. Techno-Commercial Bid) November 25, 2026, at 15:00 Hrs.at Reserve Bank of India, Estate Cell at RBI Raipur, Sector 24, Nava Raipur- 492101
l. Date & time of opening of Part-II (i.e. Price Bid) Date of opening of Part II i.e. price bid shall be informed separately
m. Period for signing of Contract Agreement 14 calendar days from issue of Letter of Award
n. Commencement Date 14 calendar days from issue of Letter of Award
o. Liquidated Damages 0.25% of the consultancy charges per week for the delay subject to maximum 10% of the consultancy charges.
p. Address for communication in connection with this tender General Manager (Officer-in-Charge), Reserve Bank of India, Estate cell, at RBI Raipur, Sector 24, Nava Raipur- 492101
q. Validity of the offer 3 months from the date of opening of part I

4. The Bank is not bound to accept the lowest Tender and reserves the right to accept either in full or in part any tender. The Bank also reserves the right to reject all the tenders without assigning any reason therefor.

5. Any amendments / corrigendum to the tender, if any, issued in future will only be notified on the RBI Website and CPP portal as given above and will not be published in the newspaper.

6. This notice is being published for information only and is not an open invitation to quote in this limited tender. Participation in this tender is by invitation only and is limited to the selected Procuring Entity’s enlisted contractors. Unsolicited offers are liable to be ignored. However, contractors who desire to participate in such tenders in future may apply for enlistment with RBI as per procedure.

General Manager (Officer-in-Charge)

Raipur

item.title: Minutes of Pre-bid Meeting - Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning (DSITC) of 3 no’s of 250 TR water cooled screw Chillers for Bank’s Main Office Building at Kanpur
item.description:
A Pre-Bid meeting in connection with e-tender No. 2026_RBI_295465, which was floated on CPP Portal and RBI website on October 23, 2026, for the captioned work, was conducted at 11:00 AM on November 12, 2026, at Estate Department, RBI Kanpur. The meeting was chaired by AGM Estate Department.

(a) List of Bank's Officials who attended the meeting:

S. N. Name of Official Designation
1. Mr. Bhanu Pratap Singh AGM
2. Mr. Sagar Singh Jadon AM
3. Mrs. Mansi Jain AM (Tech-Electrical)
4. Mr. Aviral Shukla JE (Tech-Electrical)
5. Mr. Moksh Sharma Assistant

(b) List of Contractor’s representatives who attended the meeting:

S. N. Name of Firm Name of the Representative
1. Trane Technologies Mr. Siddhartha Salwan
2. HVAC Systems Pvt. Ltd. Mr. Amit Gupta
3. Brite Industries Mr. Majid Khan
Mr. Musorof Sekh
4. Daikin Airconditioning India Pvt. Ltd. Mr. Majid Anwar
5. Voltas Ltd. Mr. Sachin Srivastava
Mr. Arpit Srivastava
6. Dunham - Bush Mr. Mayank Chauhan

2. At the outset, AGM, Estate Department welcomed the participants to the meeting and invited queries, if any, from the prospective bidders regarding the captioned tender. The queries put forth by the representative and the clarifications issued are tabulated below:

S. N. Queries/Suggestions from the firms Clarifications/Comments
1 5 star rated Chillers may be allowed. As specified in the tender or higher rated.
2 Chiller and Compressor make may be considered from the same OEM. As per OEM specification as indicated in the tender.
3 Factory acceptance test is required for all chiller or only single chiller unit. As specified in the tender but for all chillers.
4 Pump make is not mentioned in the tender document. Approved makes - Grundfos, KSB, Kirloskar Brothers, Danfoss or any other approved equivalent.
5 IE4 rated motor is not standard. As per tender.
6 Instead of SFU, MCCB may be considered. (Refer Page 68-69 'Motor Starter and protections') Acceptable.
7 Whether ASME stamping is required for both condenser and evaporator? ASME stamping is required for complete chiller and compressor unit.
8 The stipulated 3-day period for removal of scrap, debris, waste and buyback materials is insufficient. We kindly request you to extend the removal period from 3 days to 5 days from the date of completion of work. As per tender.
9 We kindly request you to extend the period for factory testing and delivery of the material at site from 10 week to 14-16 week. As per tender.
10 We kindly request you to extend the period for Dismantling of existing first chiller and Installation, commissioning of 1st new Chiller from 1 week to 2 weeks. As per tender.
11 We kindly request you to extend the period for Dismantling of existing Second chiller and Installation, commissioning of 2nd new Chiller from 1 week to 2 weeks. As per tender.
12 We kindly request you to extend the period for Installation and commissioning of 3rd new Chiller from 1 week to 2 weeks. As per tender.
13 We kindly request you to extend the period for final testing and handing
over of Installed Chiller with complete training from 1 week to 2 weeks.		 As per tender.
14 The VFD will ensure that power factor is maintained > 0. 95 at all times. The VFD will be with built in filters for controlling RFI emission and built-in chokes to suppress harmonics up to THD < 5% and THiD < 30%.
However, Power factor will be maintained more than 0.95 at 100 % only and AHF (Active harmonic filter) will be provided separately.		 As per tender.
15 We kindly request you to change the COP at AHRI conditions (minimum) from 6.2 to 6.1. As per tender.
16 Refrigerant-cooled unit-mounted VFD or Air-cooled Stand-alone VFD may also be allowed. Unit-mounted / Stand-alone Air-cooled VFD is acceptable.
17 Painting specification will be as per OEM. Painting of the chiller shall be RAL 7035 or as per OEM standards.
18 Sharing of AUTOCAD drawing of chiller plant room. Will be shared by the Bank with the successful bidder as and when required.
19 Item no. 4 of BOQ: Condenser Water Pump sets.
We understand that insulation is not required for the condenser water pump sets. Kindly confirm.		 Yes, acceptable.
20 Item no. 5 of BOQ: Insulated Valves We understand that valves installed on the condenser water piping network are not required to be insulated. Kindly confirm. Yes, acceptable.
21 Pressure gauge dial (BOQ Item 5.4) maximum diameter as per industry standard is 150 mm. 200 mm dial as mentioned in tender is not available. 150 mm diameter pressure gauge dial is also acceptable.
22 We understand that the VFD and PLC panel for the chilled water pumps shall be installed near the pump sets.
Further, we understand that the chilled water pumps are Primary Variable Flow (PVF) pumps and, accordingly, one (1) Motorized Bypass Valve shall be provided across the chilled water supply and return headers to ensure the minimum flow requirement through the chillers under all operating conditions. Kindly confirm the above understanding and advise if any further control philosophy or minimum flow arrangement is required.		 As per tender.
23 Request for change in payment terms. As per tender.
24 Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) exemption be extended to eligible MSME bidders against submission of valid Udyam Registration Certificate and other applicable statutory documents, as per prevailing Government guidelines. Kindly confirm. As per tender.
25 Power & water for erection purposes to be provided on a free issue basis. As per tender.
26 Declaration from OEM regarding Life cycle support instead of 14-year PBG. As per tender.
27 Instead of separate harmonic distortion filters at VFD etc. one harmonic filter may be placed at common coupling point at the main LT panel. This will reduce cost and cabling work and will be a prudent choice in view of the space constraints at proposed chiller plant work site. As per tender.

3. The meeting concluded at 12:15 PM on 12 November 2026.

4. Above clarifications are issued for the information of all intending bidders. Minutes of the pre-bid meeting shall form part of tender. Rest of the terms and conditions shall remain the same.
